blocks.text: Introduction (taaruf)

Is chapter mein talaba emerging technologies (nayi ubharti technologies) ke zariye computer science ke istemal dekhenge. Woh Artificial Intelligence (AI) aur rozmarra applications mein is ka istemal seekhenge, jaise voice assistants, chatbots aur image recognition (tasveer pehchanna), aur saath is ke fawaid aur challenges bhi. Chapter Internet of Things (IoT) ka taaruf karata hai aur batata hai ke jure hue devices automation (khud-kaar kaam) ke liye data kaise jama aur share karte hain. Chapter AI ke cultural (saqafati) aur ethical (akhlaqi) asraat bhi samjhata hai, jaise insaf, transparency (shaffafiyat) aur mukhtalif stakeholders (mutasir logon aur idaron) ka kirdar. Talaba dekhenge ke emerging technologies Pakistan ke qaumi masail hal karne mein kaise kaam aa sakti hain, khaas tor par smart agriculture (smart zaraat) jaise naye hal. Aakhir mein woh policies, regulations (qawaid) aur responsible innovation (zimmedarana nayi ijaad) seekhenge, aur yeh ke technology ka akhlaqi aur paidar (sustainable) istemal kyun zaroori hai.
8.1 Emerging technologies ko samajhna

Emerging technologies woh nayi aur jadeed ijadaat (innovations) hain jo logon ke rehne, kaam karne aur rabta karne ka tareeqa badal rahi hain. Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), Cloud Computing aur Blockchain jaisi technologies industries ko nayi shakal de rahi hain aur data, automation aur connectivity (aapas mein jure rehna) sambhalne ke liye zyada smart systems bana rahi hain (Figure 8.1). Yeh technologies sehat (healthcare), taleem, transport aur zaraat mein nayi ijaad la rahi hain aur kaam tez aur behtar bana rahi hain. Aaj ke digital daur mein in technologies ko samajhna bohat zaroori hai. Yeh duniya aur mulk ke masail ke naye hal deti hain, lekin data ki hifazat, akhlaqi fikr aur automation par zyada inhisar jaise naye masle bhi lati hain. In technologies ke baare mein seekh kar log in ki salahiyat samajh sakte hain, aane wali tabdeeliyon ki tayyari kar sakte hain, aur inhein zimmedari se muashre ki behtari ke liye use kar sakte hain.

Note: yeh sehat, taleem, naql-o-haml aur zara'at mein use hoti aur hifazat aur akhlaqi sawal bhi uthati hain.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: AI, IoT, Cloud Computing aur Blockchain jaisi emerging technologies agla digital inqilab (revolution) bana rahi hain, aur duniya bhar ke logon, data aur devices ko jor rahi hain.
Artificial Intelligence (AI)

Artificial Intelligence (AI) computer science ki woh shaakh hai jo machines ko aise kaam karne ke qabil banati hai jin ke liye aam tor par insani zehanat (intelligence) chahiye hoti hai (Figure 8.2). AI computers ko data analyze karne, patterns pehchanne aur kam se kam insani madad se faisle karne deti hai. AI systems tajurbe se seekhte hain; is process ko machine learning kehte hain, jis mein algorithms ko bohat sare data par train kiya jata hai taake woh trends pehchanein aur waqt ke saath behtar hon. System jitna zyada data process kare, us ke nataij utne zyada durust hote hain.

AI data, algorithms aur computing power ko mila kar zaheen kaam karti hai, jaise baat samajhna, tasveeron mein cheezein pehchanna aur nataij ka andaza lagana. Yeh Neural Networks (NN) aur Natural Language Processing (NLP, insani zaban samajhne wali technology) use karti hai taake insani dimagh ki tarah information process kare. Is se AI pecheeda masail hal kar sakti, kaam khud-kaar bana sakti, aur un jagahon par madad kar sakti hai jahan aam programming ghair-yaqeeni surat-e-haal ya bohat zyada information nahi sambhal sakti.
AI ke aam istemal (maslan voice assistants, chatbots, image recognition)

AI bohat se tools aur services mein maujood hai jo log roz use karte hain. Siri, Alexa aur Google Assistant jaise voice assistants boli hui hidayat samajh kar mufeed maloomat dete ya kaam karte hain. Websites par chatbots sawalon ke jawab de kar gahakon ki madad karte hain, aur image recognition systems tasveeron aur scans se chehre, cheezein ya beemariyan pehchante hain. YouTube, Daraz aur Amazon jaise platforms ke recommendation systems bhi AI use karte hain jo user ki pasand ke mutabiq videos ya products suggest karte hain. Transport mein self-driving gariyan AI se apne ird-gird ko samajh kar mehfooz driving ke faisle karti hain. Yeh istemal technology ko zyada interactive, kaar-amad aur user ke mutabiq bante hain, aur taqreeban har digital service mein zaati (personalized) tajurba dete hain.

blocks.text: Kitab yahan platform ka naam 'Draz' chhapti hai; sahi naam Daraz hai, jaise kitab agle hisse mein khud likhti hai.
Muashre mein AI ke fawaid aur challenges

AI jadeed zindagi mein efficiency (kam waqt mein zyada kaam), durusti aur sahulat barha kar bare fawaid lati hai. Yeh takrari (repetitive) kaam insanon se tez karti hai, doctors ki beemari pehchanne (diagnosis) mein madad karti hai, aur kisanon ko faslon ki behtar nigrani mein madad deti hai. Maslan DeepMind ki AI aankh ke 3D scans analyze kar ke glaucoma jaisi aankh ki beemariyon ka andaza un ke wazeh alamat aane se pehle laga sakti hai. Karobar mein Amazon aur Daraz jaisi companies AI chatbots se hazaron users ke sawalon, jaise “Mera order kahan hai?”, ka ek hi waqt mein jawab deti hain. Karobar AI se gahakon ka rawaiya analyze karte, trends ka andaza lagate aur behtar faisle karte hain. Taleem mein AI personalized learning aur adaptive tutoring (har talib ke mutabiq parhai) mein madad deti hai.

In fawaid ke bawajood AI kuch challenges bhi lati hai jinhein ehtiyat se sambhalna zaroori hai. In mein data privacy (raazdari), naukriyon ka khatma (job displacement), aur algorithms ka bias shamil hai jo na-insafi wale nataij de sakta hai (Figure 8.2). Jab AI systems logon ki zindagi par asar dalne wale faisle karte hain to akhlaqi masle bhi uthte hain. Nayi ijaad aur zimmedari mein tawazun rakhne se AI insaniyat ke liye faidemand rehti hai, nuqsan deh nahi. In challenges ko samajhne se har shobe mein AI ka munsifana, shaffaf aur akhlaqi istemal barhta hai.

blocks.alt: Data, algorithms aur computing power AI model (machine learning) mein jate, jo vision (tasaveer, chehre), awaz aur zaban (NLP), aur faisle aur andaze deta. Neeche sabz fawaid ka dabba: tez takrari kaam, tashkhees mein madad, chatbots, zaati parhai aur faslon ki nigrani; aur surkh challenges ka dabba: raazdari, naukriyon ka khatma, bias aur logon ki zindagi par asar dalne wale faisle.

blocks.long_description: Jo model doctor ki madad karta hai woh janibdar training data par ghair-munsifana faisla bhi kar sakta hai, isi liye fawaid aur challenges saath aate hain.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Kisan drones aur sensors ke saath AI use kar ke faslon ki nigrani karte hain, jis se paidawar barhti aur zaya kam hota hai.
Internet of Things (IoT)

Internet of Things (IoT) physical devices ka aisa network hai jo internet se jure hon aur data jama, share aur us par amal kar sakein. In devices mein aam tor par sensors, processors aur communication hardware hota hai, jis se yeh mil kar samajhdari se kaam karte hain. IoT rozmarra cheezon, jaise lights, thermostats (darja hararat control karne wale aale) aur appliances ko jorta hai taake inhein door se dekha aur control kiya ja sake. Yeh aapas ka rabta rozmarra zindagi aur industry mein efficiency, sahulat aur foran (real-time) faisle behtar karta hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: IoT fridge, gariyon aur lights jaise rozmarra devices ko jorta hai taake woh khud ba khud ek doosre se “baat” kar sakein.

IoT systems devices ko Wi-Fi, Bluetooth ya cellular networks jaisi wireless communication technologies se jorte hain. Har jura hua device doosre devices ya ek central platform se khud ba khud maloomat ka tabadla karta hai. Yeh musalsal rabta ek smart mahol banata hai jahan machines aur systems kam se kam insani mehnat se mil kar kaam karte hain.

Smart gharon mein IoT ke zariye log mobile apps ya awaz ki hidayat se lights, heating, parde aur security systems control karte hain (Figure 8.3). Maslan smart LED bulb smartphone se on/off ho sakte hain aur shaam 6:00 baje khud on hone ke liye set kiye ja sakte hain. Isi tarah smart parde subah ke alarm ke saath khud khul jate hain, aur jab kamre ka darja hararat 35°C se oopar jaye to band ho jate hain taake kamra thanda rahe. Smart thermostat user ki pasand ke mutabiq darja hararat badal sakta hai, aur security cameras seedha smartphone par alert bhejte hain. Yeh systems sirf aaram hi nahi dete, balke bijli (energy) bachate aur hifazat bhi barhate hain.

Sehat ke shobe mein IoT sensors mareez ki halat, jaise dil ki dharkan, blood pressure ya glucose (sugar) ki satah, foran (real time) dekh sakte hain. Is se doctors door baith kar mareez ki sehat dekh sakte aur emergency mein jaldi amal kar sakte hain. Isi tarah zaraat mein IoT devices zameen ki nami, darja hararat aur mausam ke patterns napte hain taake pani dene (irrigation) aur fasal ka intizam behtar ho, paidawar barhe aur zaya kam ho.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Smart ghar, pehne jane wale fitness bands aur smart farms sab IoT technology se chalte hain.

blocks.alt: Baen teen input sensors (darja hararat, harkat aur roshni) controller, ESP32 jaise microcontroller, ko data dete. Controller Internet ya cloud se data ka tabadla karta, jo mobile app aur daen teen output actuators: smart light, smart fan aur smart socket se jura. Note misali qawaid: shaam 6:00 baje lights, 35 C se oopar parde band, cameras phone par alert.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.3: IoT se smart ghar: lights, thermostat aur security systems ko internet se door se dekha aur control kiya ja sakta hai (kitab ki Figure 8.3 par apna khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Sensors mehsoos karte, controller aur cloud faisla karte, aur actuators amal karte hain; phone app user ko nazar rakhne aur system badalne deti hai.

blocks.text: Data jama karna, communication aur automation

IoT teen bare kaamon se chalta hai: data jama karna, communication (rabta) aur automation. Sensors mahol se data jama karte hain, jaise darja hararat, harkat ya nami (humidity). Yeh data cloud par mabni systems ya servers ko bheja jata hai jahan is ko process aur analyze kiya jata hai. Analyze kiya hua data khud ba khud koi kaam shuru kar sakta hai, maslan kamre mein koi na ho to lights band kar dena, ya zameen sookh jaye to pani dena shuru kar dena.

Devices ka aapas mein rabta systems ko ek doosre ke saath hum-aahang (synchronized) aur kaar-amad rakhta hai. Automation haath se control ki zaroorat kam karti hai, waqt bachati aur insani ghalti kam karti hai. Foran milne wale data aur zaheen faislon ko mila kar IoT gharon, industries aur bastiyon ke liye zyada smart, mehfooz aur kaar-amad mahol banata hai.

Cloud Computing

Cloud computing aisi technology hai jo users ko apna data local computers ke bajaye door ke servers (remote servers) par store, manage aur process karne deti hai (Figure 8.4). Yeh servers internet par hote hain aur cloud service providers (cloud ki khidmat dene wali companies) inhein chalate hain. Is ka matlab hai ke users internet connection se kisi bhi waqt, kahin se bhi apna data aur applications khol sakte hain. Cloud ki wajah se taqatwar zaati computer ki zaroorat nahi rehti, kyunke zyada tar processing door ke servers par hoti hai.

Cloud computing se log aur karobar online services, jaise data storage, web hosting aur software applications, apna hardware rakhe baghair use kar sakte hain. Yeh streaming platforms, online learning systems aur mil kar kaam karne wali jagahon (collaborative workspaces) jaise jadeed digital tools chalati hai. Yeh technology bohat si rozmarra services ki bunyad (backbone) hai aur computing ko zyada lachakdar aur jura hua banati hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Jab aap Google Drive ya iCloud par document save karte hain to asal mein aap Cloud Computing use kar rahe hote hain.
Fawaid: scalability, accessibility aur kam kharch

Cloud computing ka ek bara faida scalability hai: users zaroorat ke mutabiq apni storage aur computing power aasani se barha ya ghata sakte hain, jo barhte karobar aur idaron ke liye behtareen hai. Doosra faida accessibility (rasai) hai: cloud services se users mukhtalif devices aur jagahon se kaam kar sakte hain, files haath se muntaqil kiye baghair.

Cloud computing kam kharch (cost-effective) bhi hai, kyunke mehenge servers aur maintenance staff ki zaroorat kam ho jati hai. Users aam tor par sirf utni services ki qeemat dete hain jitni use karein (pay-as-you-go model), jis se chalane ka kharch kam hota hai. In fawaid ki wajah se cloud technology un logon aur companies ke liye mufeed hai jinhein qabil-e-bharosa aur kaar-amad digital hal chahiye.
Misalein: AWS, Microsoft Azure

Bohat se mashhoor platforms rozmarra digital services ke liye cloud computing use karte hain. Amazon Web Services (AWS) web hosting, data storage aur application development ke liye bohat si cloud services deti hai, jo duniya bhar ke karobar use karte hain. Microsoft Azure bhi isi tarah ki salahiyatein deti hai, jis se developers cloud ke zariye applications bana aur chala sakte hain (Figure 8.4).

Yeh platforms dikhate hain ke cloud computing zaati files store karne se le kar bari companies ke hal tak har kaam mein madad deti hai. Documents save karna ho, websites host karna ho ya software door se chalana ho, cloud computing jadeed digital dhaanche (infrastructure) ka zaroori hissa ban chuki hai.

blocks.alt: Clients (laptop, phone, tablet, desktop) Internet se chaar tahon tak. Service models: SaaS (tayyar software jaise Gmail aur Office 365), PaaS (apps banane ke liye, maslan Google App Engine) aur IaaS (kachi computing jaise virtual machines). Management: billing, nigrani aur scaling, security. Deployment: public, private aur hybrid cloud. Infrastructure: servers aur storage, databases aur networking, data centres.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.4: Cloud computing se users internet ke zariye kahin se bhi data store, access aur share karte hain (kitab ki Figure 8.4 par apna khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Google Drive SaaS product hai jo log seedha use karte hain; AWS aur Azure aise platforms hain jo karobar aur developers ko teeno service models dete hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 8.4 mein teesre service model ka naam 'Iaas' chhapa hai. Sahi naam IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service) hai, jaise SaaS aur PaaS mein aakhri 'S' bara hai; isi liye yahan IaaS likha gaya hai.
Blockchain technology

Blockchain technology ek digital system hai jo maloomat ek central server ke bajaye bohat se computers par mehfooz tareeqe se store aur share karta hai. Har tasdeeq shuda (verified) record, yani block, apne se pichhle block se jura hota hai, aur yun ek aisi zanjeer (chain) banti hai jo badli nahi ja sakti. Kyunke har computer ke paas is ki copy hoti hai, is liye data ko chupke se badalna taqreeban na-mumkin hai. Yeh decentralized (kisi ek markaz ke baghair) banawat banks ya hukoomat jaise darmiyani idaron (intermediaries) ki zaroorat khatam kar ke transparency, hifazat aur bharosa barhati hai. Is se logon aur idaron ke darmiyan seedha, durust aur jawabdeh len-den hota hai.

Blockchain ke bohat si industries mein istemal hain. Finance mein yeh Bitcoin jaisi cryptocurrencies chalata hai taake log seedha aur mehfooz len-den (peer-to-peer transactions) kar sakein. Supply chain mein yeh maal ko us ki asal jagah se gahak tak track karta aur asli hone ki tasdeeq karta hai. Data ki hifazat mein yeh qanooni kaghzaat, medical files aur certificates jaise records ke liye aisi storage deta hai jis mein chhed-chhaar (tamper) nahi ho sakti. Hukoomatein, companies aur schools zameen ke records, supply chains aur taleemi asnaad (academic credentials) sambhalne ke liye blockchain use karte hain. Mukhtasar yeh ke blockchain digital systems mein bharosa, transparency aur efficiency barhata hai.

blocks.alt: Teeron se jure chaar blocks. Har aik mein data, apna hash aur pichhle block ka hash (block 1 prev 0000, hash 7a3f; block 2 prev 7a3f; block 3 prev c91e; block 4 prev 05bd). Block 3 surkh, note: ise badalne se is ka hash badalta, is liye block 4 ka prev mel nahi khata. Neeche paanch computers har aik ke paas poori nakal; koi wahid malik nahi, is liye chhupi tabdeeli taqreeban na-mumkin.
blocks.caption: Jure hue blocks record ko badalna mushkil kaise banate hain (blockchain par apna khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Hash block ke mawad se nikla mukhtasar fingerprint hai; mawad mein koi bhi tabdeeli bilkul alag fingerprint deti hai. Dikhaye gaye hashes banawati mukhtasar misalein hain.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Cryptocurrency se supply chain tracking tak, blockchain transparency ke zariye bharosa banata hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: AI: insani zehanat wale kaam karne wali machines; fawaid (efficiency, durusti) aur challenges (privacy, naukriyan, bias).
IoT: internet se jure devices data jama karte, rabta rakhte aur khud kaam karte hain.
Cloud: door ke servers par data; scalability, accessibility, kam kharch (AWS, Azure).
Blockchain: bohat se computers par jure blocks; badalna taqreeban na-mumkin.
